**Import alias strategy:** `vite.config.js` maps `@shared/*` → `shared/*`, so every module imports like:
```ts
import { ObjectPool } from '@shared/pooling/ObjectPool';
import { ParticleManager } from '@shared/particles/ParticleManager';
```

---

### Compliance Statements

**Anti-Lazy Directive:** Every function, method, and class will be fully implemented with complete logic. No `// ... rest of function`, no placeholders, no stubs. If a file is too long for one output, I will stop mid-file and resume exactly where cut off upon "continue".

**Strict Memory Management:** All geometries, materials, textures, and meshes will have `.dispose()` called on cleanup. Object pools prevent allocation churn. The ParticleManager enforces a hard 500-particle cap. No leaks.

**Sequential Output Protocol:** I will not create any files or run any commands until you name the game and approve the plan. Step 1 is text-only. Awaiting your command.
